newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia PMI plans bonus, rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia PMI plans bonus, rights issue.

text.p: Pan Malaysian Industries Bhd (PMI) has proposed a one-for-four bonus issue of 114.32 million new shares and a three-for-two rights issue of 685.89 million shares at an issue price of 1.0 ringgit each.
PMI said in a statement on Friday that it also planned a special issue of 63.90 million news shares to bumiputera (ethnic Malay) investors at 1.0 ringgit per share.

PMI, whose businesses include department store operations, property and cement, said proceeds from the rights and special issues would be used to repay borrowings, subscribe to a rights issue proposed by a subsidiary and for working capital.
PMI's paid-up capital will increase to 1.32 billion shares of 0.50 ringgit each from the existing 457.26 million upon completion of the proposals.
PMI said the proposals would reduce the group net tangible assets per share to 1.09 ringgit from 1.53 ringgit.
